mapper.update: UPDATE sso_configurations SET client_id = #{clientId}, client_secret_ref = #{clientSecretRef}, issuer_uri = #{issuerUri}, redirect_uri = #{redirectUri}, scopes = #{scopes}, is_active = #{active}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, is_deleted = #{deleted}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
